comment: Machines people have asked about, and near neighbours of the proven MacBookPro9,2, with only public facts: model identifier, GPU families from patches.py's GPUS, and firmware from FIRMWARE. A candidate is not a target: it has no board id, CPU flags, PCI list, ioreg or ESP, because those can only come from the machine (docs/candidates.md).

candidates.name: MacBook Pro (Retina, 15-inch, Early 2013)
candidates.why: The closest 15-inch to the proven 9,2: same Ivy Bridge generation and HD 4000, plus a Kepler GT 650M the release has no recipe for yet. A target would have to decide which GPU the image drives.
candidates.source: Apple's MacBook Pro (Retina, 15-inch, Early 2013) specifications: Intel HD Graphics 4000 and NVIDIA GeForce GT 650M.

candidates.name: MacBook Pro (Retina, 15-inch, Late 2013)
candidates.why: Haswell with Iris Pro 5200 and no discrete GPU: the cleanest first machine for an intel-hsw recipe.
candidates.source: Apple's MacBook Pro (Retina, 15-inch, Late 2013) specifications: Intel Iris Pro Graphics.

candidates.name: MacBook Pro (16-inch, 2019)
candidates.why: The reported Navi14/T2 machine: the AMD X6000 stack is a different port, and T2 is a separate question. Its Coffee Lake integrated GPU is not a family in patches.py's GPUS, so only the discrete GPU is listed.
candidates.source: GitHub issue #80: MacBookPro16,1, Radeon Pro 5500M (Navi14) at 1002:7340, T2.

candidates.name: Haswell and Broadwell integrated graphics (generation request)
candidates.why: A generation request with no machine named.
candidates.source: GitHub issue #2; the generation's GPU families are intel-hsw and intel-bdw in patches.py's GPUS.

candidates.name: HP EliteBook 840 G4 (Kaby Lake, Intel HD 620)
candidates.why: A Kaby Lake hackintosh with HD 620; the issue reports a sanitised hao report and a working Tahoe graphics stack.
candidates.source: GitHub issue #5: i5-7300U, Intel HD Graphics 620 (8086:5916), SMBIOS MacBookPro16,2.

candidates.name: Skylake integrated graphics (generation request)
candidates.why: A generation request with no machine named.

candidates.name: HP Pavilion dv6-7070ex (Ivy Bridge, Intel HD 4000)
candidates.why: An Ivy Bridge hackintosh that would reuse the 9,2 patch sets; non-Apple firmware is an open scope question.
candidates.source: GitHub issue #4: i7-3610QM, Intel HD Graphics 4000.

candidates.name: VMware SVGA 3D (virtual machine, software graphics)
candidates.why: A virtual-machine graphics device: the generic, software path, not a platform GPU. The issue's AMD part is the same Navi question as #80.
